description: NULL values sort FIRST in ascending ORDER BY (SQLite default: NULLs are less than any value)

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE scores (id INTEGER, score INTEGER)
SELECT id, score FROM scores ORDER BY score ASC
steps.note: ASC: NULLs sort before all numeric values (SQLite: NULL < everything)

steps.sql: SELECT id, score FROM scores ORDER BY score DESC
steps.note: DESC: NULLs sort after all numeric values (NULL is still smallest, so DESC puts them last)

steps.sql: SELECT id FROM scores WHERE score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY score ASC
steps.note: Filtering NULLs out with IS NOT NULL, then sorting
